data.name: Nazraana
data.gender_notes: Nazraana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'nazara' meaning 'to observe'. This name signifies a watchful and observant individual, who is attentive to the world around them and mindful of their actions. The name Nazraana carries the meaning “Observant, Watchful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nazraana usually hope their child will grow to embody observant, watchful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with spiritual significance in Islam, often given to those who are deeply contemplative and introspective.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nazraana total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
